warranty_program.excludes: Improper use, heat damage, impact, staining from chemicals, non-residential use
warranty_program.summary: Limited lifetime warranty — NOT transferable, single-family only. Weakest warranty positioning among major quartz brands.

service_network.coverage: National — largest distributor footprint in US
service_network.dealer_network: Broad retail + fabricator network; available at Home Depot

company_stability.manufacturing: Sources from 25+ global suppliers. One domestic facility in Latta, SC (Q Studio Collection).

reputation_pattern.fabricator_consensus: Solid mid-tier option. Reliable, competitive pricing. Consistency varies by sourcing.
key_concerns: Distributor-brand model (no own manufacturing for most lines)
